top_signals.title: DWS Americas CEO: Europe Is a Bet on a Physical Economy
top_signals.summary: DWS Americas CEO Hepsen Uzcan discusses whether investors are getting enough clarity from Kevin Warsh and other Fed members about monetary policy. Uzcan says the Fed has paused rate changes, not its fight against inflation. She speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
